itens.trecho: If you enjoy reading my Spoiler-Free reviews, please follow my blog :) I don’t have a written review for each of the previous films, but I did watch both and thoroughly enjoyed them! John Wick (2014) is one of the best movies of that year and one of the best action films ever.
The franchise keeps getting better Igitur qui desiderat pacem, praeparet bellum. - Publius Flavius Vegetius Renatus; De re militari (4th or 5th century AD) It wasn't just a puppy.

It's got the curse of the third movie, this - the script has been almost totally sacrificed for the imagery (which for the first 20 minutes is actually quite stunning). The fight scenes seem to go on and on well beyond the point where even Arnie would have been killed.
